name: SPViewer
description: Ship and vehicle performance database: hydrogen, capacitors, power, cooling, signatures, fleet rankings, and cutaway layouts. StarTracker embeds the same wiki datamine tables SPViewer is built on.

name: ERkul DPS Calculator
description: Ship and component DPS, power, cooling, and heat simulations. Best for planning full weapon loadouts.

name: ERkul Loadout Planner
description: Pick a hull and slot weapons, shields, coolers, and power plants with live stat sidebar.

name: Hardpoint.io
description: Ship fitting and comparison with hull HP, turret coverage, and cross-ship stats.

name: FleetYards
description: Ship specs, variants, and fleet planning.

name: Star Citizen Wiki
description: Item and vehicle datamine pages. Primary data source for StarTracker combat and performance stats.
